dialogue.speech: Did I become so small that Li'l Bomber's power also shrank?

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: What?!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: Damn it!

dialogue.name: Nara
dialogue.speech: I'll just make them bigger!

dialogue.name: Form
dialogue.speech: Tiny Feet!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Who's going to fight him?!

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: Next, they head to the Pompeii Archaeological Park as instructed by the boss,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Hold on, Fugo. I have no idea what you're talking about.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: and Fugo is pulled into the world of mirrors by another member of the Hitman Team, Illuso.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Is something wrong with the mirror?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: This isn't good! He's going to attack!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Get away from the mirror!

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: What?

dialogue.name: Fugo
dialogue.speech: Giorno! Abbacchio!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: When Purple Smoke uses its fists, no one can stay nearby.

dialogue.name: Nar
dialogue.speech: But then, Fugo's terrifying Stand ability, feared by even his friends, is revealed.

dialogue.name: Illuso
dialogue.speech: What the hell is with these corpses?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: It's a k*ller virus.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: That's Fugo's Stand, Purple Smoke's ability.

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: A virus?

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: Look at its hand.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: When it hits something with its fist, that capsule breaks open,

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: and the virus comes spilling out!

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: It infects its host within thirty seconds, then kills them instantly.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: And once the virus spreads, it doesn't matter who's nearby, be they friend or foe.

dialogue.name: Abba
dialogue.speech: I knew it... Fugo's unable to control it.

dialogue.name: Illu
dialogue.speech: You're finished. Take this!

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Even more powerful enemies are bound to attack Giorno and the others in the future!

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Will Giorno and the others successfully be able to protect Trish

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: and carry out the boss's orders?

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Also, will Giorno and Bucciarati be able to achieve their true goal?

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: The journey has only just begun for Giorno and his friends!
